subject: how to set upper and lower bound of the ability estimates?

messages.author: 40fc57d53124bd8d
messages.subject: how to set upper and lower bound of the ability estimates?
parts:
How can I set the upper and lower bounds of the ability estimates? In my code, I have the highlighted part to set the upper and lower bounds but it doesn't work. 

          mirt(
            minDat,
            1,
            itemtype = 'gpcm',
            pars = 'values',
            D = 1,
            technical = list(theta_lim = c(-4, 4))
          )

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: how to set upper and lower bound of the ability estimates?
parts:
Hi Emily,

Do you mean when using the fscores() function? There's a max_theta argument there. The theta_lim in the estimation here is for numerical integration, which you definitely do not want to touch. 

Phil

messages.subject: Re: how to set upper and lower bound of the ability estimates?
parts:
> args(fscores)

function (object, method = "EAP", full.scores = TRUE, rotate = "oblimin", 
    Target = NULL, response.pattern = NULL, append_response.pattern = TRUE, 
    na.rm = FALSE, plausible.draws = 0, plausible.type = "normal", 
    quadpts = NULL, returnER = FALSE, return.acov = FALSE, mean = NULL, 
    cov = NULL, verbose = TRUE, full.scores.SE = FALSE, theta_lim = c(-6, 
        6), MI = 0, use_dentype_estimate = FALSE, QMC = FALSE, 
    custom_den = NULL, custom_theta = NULL, min_expected = 1, 
    converge_info = FALSE, max_theta = 20, start = NULL, ...) 
NULL

If you want all theta estimates to be capped at [-4,4], change max_theta = 4.

Phil
